label: GOD_LIKE_5: GodLike P x w: at world w, x has every property that is positive at w
definition: `GodLike P x w`: at world w, x has every property that is positive at w (AFP definition G = (λx. ∀(λΦ. P Φ m→ Φ x))). The theory's prose calls it 'God-like' and its theorems' glosses say 'God'; the formalized notion is only this.
